reviews.text: Unique satisfaction, a compliment to the girls, it's the first time I've worn my Rocky, and to tell the truth they gave me good advice.... thank you!

What can I say?...Emma is simply wonderful with our four-legged friends. She pampers them with so much love and is excellent at her job. She dedicates so much time to the dog without ever looking at the clock. Congratulations, a guarantee at a good price.
It was the first time I took my dog ​​to be washed, I must say everyone was very helpful and kind. Thank you so much.

I think it's the best shop in the area, both for the friendliness of the staff and the results achieved after a bath.
My dog ​​always enjoys returning to be bathed there; he never thinks twice about coming in wagging his tail, and every time he picks up his coat, it smells wonderful and is as soft as silk.
Although I've tried other shops, to date I can confirm that Beauty Dog And Cat is the best ❤️‍🩹
The shop also stocks many items for our pets, and for the Christmas holidays, I bought a Christmas Star panettone there so my dog ​​will also celebrate the holidays with gusto 🎉
Thank you for being there for our furry friends.
Until the next bath!
